tff19260d: Software for training centres and sports clubs · Turnera
t2a0dea38: Personal trainers, spinning, functional, yoga or Pilates studios and padel or tennis clubs: the diary by room or by court, classes with their places, session packs and payment, in the same application. No booking commission: the fee is the fee, and your members are yours.
tc097f011: What a training centre uses every day.

t88a54322: Each court or room is a resource and the day is shown court by court. Casual hire, private lessons and group lessons live side by side, because what changes between them is a number in the catalogue.
t0df5bd33: Ten sessions bought in one go and used over two months: the record shows how many each member has left and when they expire, and they’re deducted automatically at checkout.

t0a90d3e3: The Monday and Thursday class is set up once. Before saving, the diary shows which days fit and why it skips the others: a public holiday, another appointment at that time.
tc7e88f58: Your members book and cancel from your centre’s portal, signing in with their email and no passwords. You decide how far in advance, until when they can cancel and who can book without a pack.
t8ccee080: A ticket with services and products, session packs, coupons, gift cards and club points, outstanding payments and the day’s till close.

t26926045: Every slot in your diary that can be occupied at the same time. If your centre can see three people at once, that's three resources.
t63ac3236: Two rooms worked in parallel are two resources. If two practitioners take turns in the same room and never overlap, it's one.

t963dbcba: Do you take a percentage of what the centre bills?
t94b62d9a: No. Not of what you bill, not of each booking, not of each payment, and not of new clients who come in through the portal. Your clients are yours and what you charge is entirely yours.
tda3fe7ba: I have two centres. Do I pay twice?
tbdd23f09: Two premises with three rooms each are a single installation of six resources, and you pay €69 a month, the same as one centre with six rooms under one roof.
te8114992: The number of centres doesn't change the price: only the resources count, wherever they are.
t1edc2731: Each branch has its own diary, its own till and its own reports, with management seeing it all together. Opening a second site doesn't cost you anything for the fact of opening it; it costs you if, by opening it, you can see more people at once, which is only fair.
tca882680: Can my clients book on their own?
t5c1a81a0: Yes. Your centre has its own booking portal, at your Turnera address, where your clients see what is free, book and cancel. They sign in with their email, with no passwords to remember.
tab8e2654: You set the rules in the preferences: how many days ahead can be booked, how much notice is needed, until when a booking can be cancelled, who can book without a voucher and whether someone with an outstanding debt can keep booking. You decide when to switch it on and which services and rooms are booked online.
t596cd2aa: Does it work with my card terminal?
tfaae2bac: Turnera records the payment and the payment method, and the till report reconciles with whatever your terminal says. We don't handle the money: you collect it, into your account, with whatever payment gateway you already have.
t543d79e4: Can I try it before paying?
t3bf1f820: Thirty days, no card. You come in with sample data already loaded — clients, services, today's appointments — so you see how it behaves when full, not in front of an empty screen. When you start with real ones, they're deleted in one click.
tf7372a6b: No. If you pay monthly, you cancel whenever you like: you keep access until the end of the month you've already paid for, and you're not charged again.
